title_en: Artificial Intelligence (20/20): The Invisible Smart City
note_en: 之所以……是因为…… explains the reason for something already known, putting the result first and the cause second: 这座城市之所以运行得这么顺畅，是因为背后有无数这样看不见的智能系统 "the reason this city runs so smoothly is that countless invisible smart systems are behind it." It works like English "the reason ... is that ...": 之所以 goes after the subject of the first clause, and 是因为 opens the second. Compare 因为……所以……, which gives the cause first.
